product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides an AI-powered eDiscovery and investigations platform for corporate legal teams, law firms, legal service providers, government, and education organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and the /pricing URL is a demo-request page rather than a page listing plans or prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Reveal customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 478 employees, within this band.

hq_location.notes: Reveal lists Chicago, Illinois as its North American headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company identifies itself as founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The visible blog listings are product, customer, and practical eDiscovery content; I found no evidence of at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Reveal provides a public documentation site with multiple product categories/articles and a support page linking multiple product documentation areas.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The visible open-position list contains no AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.value: Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI
model_provider.notes: Reveal says its AI-assisted review supports both providers by region.

compliance_certs.notes: These labels appear on Reveal’s Trust Center.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies a $200 million growth-equity round on January 26, 2021; Reveal’s announcement says K1 invested more than $200 million in the combined organization.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding record found is dated January 2021, well before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open positions include Account Executive II and Accounts Executive I.

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal’s October 2026 product update announces newly shipped features, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude connectors.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The documented CEO transition/start was in October 2025, before the window began on November 9, 2025; no C-level or VP change within the requested period was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An open Account Executive II posting explicitly names Salesforce CRM.
